title: FREE REQUEST Looking for sprite artist to help me finish my jam entry

posts.author: Amiel1124
posts.body:
Engine: RPG Maker MV
Artstyle: Any
My Role: Creator/artist/eventor (etc.)
Help Needed: NPC designers and animators
I had two artists working with me, but one of them dropped out due to time constraints. While the remaining artist I'm working with is very good, just the two of us doesn't seem like it is going to be enough to finish the game by July 7th (last possible day), especially with my own art skills lacking. As such, I am very much in need of one more artist who can help us eek out a completed product. Mainly, NPCs are a major thing that needs work done on. My game is a Yume Nikki Fangame called "Milk", which has been updated on and off since 2019. If you are interested in helping work on the game, please reply here or message me on discord at amiel1124. Thank you kindly.
MILK by amiel1124
